Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on your Hawaii vacation itinerary (June 10-20, 2024), here's your comprehensive packing list:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple pieces for beach days and water activities)
- Sunscreen (high SPF for tropical sun protection)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (for daily activities and dining)
- Camera (to capture memories)
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, reservations)

Activity-Specific Items:
- Beach gear (for Waikiki Beach day)
- Snorkeling equipment (for Hanauma Bay)
- Hiking boots/shoes (for Diamond Head trail)
- Comfortable walking shoes (for Pearl Harbor visit)
- Light jacket or sweater (for air-conditioned venues)
- Shopping bags (for Ala Moana Center)

Additional Recommendations:
- Sunglasses
- Hat for sun protection
- Beach towel
- Water bottle
- First aid kit
- Insect repellent
